notes.title: Engines of Destruction Playtest 2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42114909/9d1e774193e5cd167a0c427e1c83df9ff2c6b0e6.png[/img]

[h1]Announcement regarding upcoming playtest[/h1]
Hey everyone!

With playtest 2 on the horizon we have some details to share with you about what to expect:

[h2]VR Postponed[/h2]
We want the first time people step into EOD mechs in VR to be a special experience, for this reason we have decided to delay the VR to the next playtest. While it is functional, it needs a bit more time and attention to iron out some issues we've identified. Apologies to everyone who was anticipating playing VR this weekend, we plan to host an extra public test as soon as we can with VR support.

[h2]Servers[/h2]
We will be using the previous server method from public playtest 1 as the new method isn't yet deployed. This may result in some familiar issues, or a brief choke up where servers aren't available. On top of this matchmaking with friends is not yet available.

[h2]The Good News[/h2]
Apart from that, most of EOD is working! New maps, customisation options, weapons and more are available in this test. We can't wait to hear what you think of it.

Make sure you sign up on the store page, and see you in the game soon!

notes.title: EOD First Playtest
notes.content:
[h1] Playtest Currently Underway! [/h1]

EOD's first ever test is currently ongoing. We're having a ton of fun jumping in matches with everyone (and fixing no small number of bugs). 

This first test includes only an early test of the PvP mode on desktop, with no VR yet.

The playtest will run until [b]20:00 GMT[/b] on Monday 3rd. 

If you'd like to join us ingame, you can get access via the store page.

And we'd love to hear what you have to say about the game in our [url=https://discord.gg/BJmGjbpaCE]Discord[/url] or via our [url=https://forms.gle/89u5CdZGZYFZJMkJA]feedback form[/url].
